title: Flat 64-bit 5-window Eisenstein stored-leaf birthday search on secp256k1 with reversed-BT2 BIC, 4096/16384-record blocks, 5B/3B+3A classes, and Leaf-3 tail duplication

claims.statement: For uniform unrestricted production secp256k1 ECDLP challenges and fresh algorithm coins, the grouped stored-leaf search in proof.md has success probability at least 0.39 and an upper bound 123.133359612279188 on log2(total expected classical computation in the fixed C=1000 scalar AArch64 instruction normalization). All preprocessing, failed paths, arithmetic, address/control work, transfers, verification and output are included across processors. Peak reserved memory is below 2^138 bytes; there is no free advice or future-target amortization. The estimate uses the explicitly disclosed uniform 64-bit flat analytical address space per processor (under COST_MODEL.md's scalar 64-bit instruction basis, matching the disclosed convention of submissions 4e2d5241 and 8cc64cb7) with five-window (52,51,51,51,51) BT/P1/E/G tables (including reversed window-4 BIC on both P1_5WIN and BLK5F/BT2_51x2) and five-window (45,45,45,44,44) F/fwd tables at NODES=2^58, two-class five-window Eisenstein assignments (E: 3B+2A+A, F/G: 5B) with balanced (21,21,24,22) canonical labels, Leaf-3 tail duplication in keys, explicit TBZ/TBNZ block ends (zero VMSAv9 stage-1 permission faults) on 4096-record hop-1 and 16384-record hop-2 blocks, a 45,000-group schedule at Q1GD=256*109000000000, a 128-bit cumulative fixup meter (DELTA_F=2^100) integrated in ytransport.s:ychunk, and the explicit scalar memory-fabric services (MSG=256, GEN_MUL=912688), denominator-cleared selected-X fiber bound (selected-x.md), self-contained five-window Lemmas E/F/M/K/R/V and pointwise joint-label derivation (success.md Section 7), and global pair-inverse exclusion. The finite experiment establishes only its stated exact-rational certificate, instruction-form, finite simulated EC label, six-X resolver-model, reply-handle, pre-ticket-filter, encoding-range, hop-1 delivery, routing-flush, production-driver, meter, bit-extraction, map, and negative-control checks, not production execution, RTL synthesis, or a production collision law.

experiments.purpose: Run exact certificate plus independent schedule/logarithm/gate/memory/cost/fiber checks, finite GF1024 and selected-X algebra, 144 exact EC leaves carried through modelled hop-1 blocks and the relay's h2s into hop-2 windows and checked there, production archive and forwarding boundaries, scalar kernel counts with every hop-2 trampoline and the cap-clamp return, a finite six-X resolver model, the reply handle end to end (48 messages, DPW_RCB's ends, 2^56), the pre-ticket filter against psel, top-index inserts, CN's boundary, region-in-encoding checks, and listed negative controls. Simulate the table builders across classes and compare actual per-row counts with the charged bounds. The wrapper restores nine hashed runtime sources from two archives and tests four codec failures on each. Optional source returns one restored source file without running the suite.
